nodes.description: Immutable ERC20 token contract being held by the timelock.
Immutable address of the beneficiary allowed to receive the locked tokens.
Immutable timestamp after which the locked tokens may be released.
Constructor that validates releaseTime_ against block.timestamp and initializes token, beneficiary and release time.
View accessor returning the held ERC20 token instance (_token).
View accessor returning the beneficiary address (_beneficiary).
View accessor returning the release timestamp (_releaseTime).
Transfers all held tokens to the beneficiary once block.timestamp reaches the release time.
View helper returning the token balance currently locked in this contract.
Block timestamp used for release-time comparisons in the constructor and in release().
External token transfer call token().safeTransfer(beneficiary(), amount) which hands control to an arbitrary token contract.
Constructor parameter supplying the ERC20 token contract address to be held.
Constructor parameter supplying the beneficiary address.
Constructor parameter supplying the release timestamp.
Local variable holding the token balance of this contract read in release().
Low-level recipient.call{value: amount} forwarding all gas to an arbitrary address.
Library helper performing a value transfer with a low-level call.
Payable recipient address supplied to sendValue.
Wei amount supplied to sendValue and forwarded in the low-level call.
Low-level target.call{value: value}(data) forwarding value and calldata to an arbitrary target.
Target contract address supplied to functionCallWithValue.
Wei value supplied to functionCallWithValue and attached to the call.
SafeERC20 wrapper that encodes and performs a transfer through _callOptionalReturn.

edges.reason: Constructor condition requires releaseTime_ > block.timestamp, making initialization dependent on the block timestamp.
release() gate require(block.timestamp >= releaseTime()) controls whether the transfer can be executed, creating timestamp dependency.
Constructor parameter token_ is assigned into the state variable _token.
Constructor parameter beneficiary_ is assigned into the state variable _beneficiary.
Constructor parameter releaseTime_ is assigned into the state variable _releaseTime.
releaseTime() returns the state variable _releaseTime.
token() returns the state variable _token.
beneficiary() returns the state variable _beneficiary.
release() reads the release time via releaseTime() in its require check.
release() invokes token() to obtain the token contract before transferring.
release() invokes beneficiary() to determine the transfer recipient.
release() triggers the external token transfer through safeTransfer.
token().balanceOf(address(this)) is stored into the local variable amount.
Local variable amount is passed as the value forwarded to the external safeTransfer call.
sendValue executes the low-level call to recipient.
sendValue parameter amount is attached as the value of the low-level call.
sendValue parameter recipient becomes the callee of the low-level call.
functionCallWithValue parameter target becomes the callee of the low-level call.
functionCallWithValue parameter value is attached as the value of the low-level call.
SafeERC20.safeTransfer performs the encoded external call represented by the unsafe operation.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor parameter token_ only exists to initialize state and can be folded into the constructor node.
Constructor parameter beneficiary_ only exists to initialize state and can be folded into the constructor node.
Constructor parameter releaseTime_ is the value checked against block.timestamp and can be folded into the constructor node.
Local variable amount is consumed directly as the value of the external safeTransfer call and can be folded into that unsafe operation.
sendValue parameter recipient is consumed directly as the callee of the low-level call and can be folded into that unsafe operation.
sendValue parameter amount is consumed directly as the call value and can be folded into that unsafe operation.
functionCallWithValue parameter target is consumed directly as the callee of the low-level call and can be folded into that unsafe operation.
functionCallWithValue parameter value is consumed directly as the call value and can be folded into that unsafe operation.
